refinement.detail: Searched and found none that this ticket may apply. HP-06 is an evaluation ticket: its slice is the measurement, and a ticket whose evaluation changes the thing it evaluates has no measurement left to report. Applying a refinement to the model here would move the artefact the three goals were just decided against, after the numbers were known. THE SEARCH DID FIND REAL REFINEMENT WORK, and it is FILED rather than applied, which is the correct disposition for a measurement: * HP-06-DF-10 / HP-03's committed measurement -- this repository's `Refuse*`-style profile change produces 90.7% of a corpus and ZERO executable cases, because a refusal action's parameters appear nowhere in its body. That is a refinement question about how refusals are modeled, and it is now measured on two fixtures. * The blind-author channel's BA-F1..BA-F5 -- five ways the A/B fixture's model does not refine its own FEATURE.md, including a COMMIT record with three fields where the feature's has four. That is refinement work on HP-01's fixture, not on this repository's model, and HP-01's fixture is sealed evidence this ticket may not edit. * HP-06-DF-11 -- the oracle re-derives a reservation id the model does not allocate that way, which is HP-03-DF-01's "a model that guards an id its own API allocates rather than accepts" seen from the other side. None is a refinement of `TlaSpecDevCli`, which is the module this ledger is about, and none was applied.

summary: EVALUATION: the A/B judged blind. GOAL-hexagonal-in-fact MET (D3 = 4 from both judges, the first 4 outside D5 in this project's history); GOAL-catch-bugs MET (D1 = 3 from both judges, guard relaxation 3 of 3 under the negative corpus and 1 of 1 on a fresh blind catalogue); GOAL-simpler-same-behavior MISSED (D2 = 2 from all four judges -- an A/B cannot reach anchor 3). The prompt produced the structure and the structure caught nothing: 49 of 49 comparable kill cells identical between the arms. The positive control is RED on arm A. 7 PASS / 4 FAIL on the sealed predictions, three of the four failures negative. Findings by channel 0 suite : 17 adversarial : 13 blind author. Twelve findings filed, none fixed; six of HP-06's own claims falsified and corrected in place.

assertions: Both arms scored by two judges blind to arm; every scorecard passes the schema check; contested dimensions adjudicated with NEW evidence.
Every prediction in PREDICTIONS-HP.md scored PASS / FAIL / SUPERSEDED. None amended.
Each goal reports baseline -> measured -> target with a verdict of met / missed / unmeasured and a reason.
Findings reported BY CHANNEL with counts, and the ratio stated as a result.
acceptance.close_note: TWO GOALS MET, ONE MISSED, AND BOTH `met` VERDICTS CARRY A CAVEAT THAT MUST NEVER BE SEPARATED FROM THEM. GOAL-hexagonal-in-fact MET. Arm B scored D3 = 4 from BOTH blind judges against arm A's 2 and 2. THE FIRST 4 ON ANY DIMENSION BUT D5 IN THIS PROJECT'S HISTORY, and D3 had never passed 3. Both judges earned it by RUNNING the artifact's real-adapter/fake parity suite rather than believing its notes, and both checked specifically for the hole HP-02's pilot found in an earlier draft of the same prompt -- the shipped sentence that closed it was never re-measured by HP-02 and this was its first measurement. CAVEAT: 105 unique prompt lines against 16, so this round CANNOT distinguish "hexagonal guidance helped" from "a longer, more specific ask helped", and n = 1. GOAL-catch-bugs MET. D1 = 3 from both judges on arm B against a baseline where nothing reached 3 anywhere. Guard relaxation 3 of 3 under the negative corpus on the seeded catalogue and 1 of 1 on a fresh independently authored one, on both arms, against 0 of 3 under every other generated instrument. CAVEAT: THE POSITIVE CONTROL IS RED ON ARM A -- M07 survives all six generated instruments because the corpus recovers no `Reserve` argument, exactly as HP-05 recorded one ticket earlier -- so every whole-view row is a floor under a broken control. The D1 anchor is carried by `corpus-neg`, whose controls are green. GOAL-simpler-same-behavior MISSED. D2 = 2 from all four judges on both arms. The target was NOT moved. It was missed for a reason nobody predicted: neither arm made a simplification and measured one, because both implemented one specification from scratch, and D2 anchor 3 needs a before and an after OF THE SAME ARTIFACT. The owner's amendment proposed reading the arm pair as the before/after; that reading was supplied to every judge and NO JUDGE ACCEPTED IT. D2 as written cannot be scored above 2 by an A/B at all -- HP-06-DF-05, a finding about the card. THE PROMPT PRODUCED THE STRUCTURE AND THE STRUCTURE CAUGHT NOTHING. Every per-mutant verdict is IDENTICAL between the arms on 49 of 49 comparable cells across seven instruments. Arm B's own 41 tests appear in no kill table; both judges said so and both capped D1 for it. THE GENERATOR IS STILL WORSE THAN A SUITE WRITTEN IN AN AFTERNOON, and a catalogue nobody tuned beats them both down. Seeded catalogue: suite 10 of 10, generated corpora 9 of 10 with the positive control as the survivor. FRESH INDEPENDENTLY AUTHORED CATALOGUE: corpora 8 of 13, suite 9 of 13, and FOUR whole classes invisible to every instrument INCLUDING the suite. A catalogue written by the author of the mechanisms flatters both instruments by roughly a quarter. SEALED PREDICTIONS: 7 PASS, 4 FAIL, 0 SUPERSEDED, 0 UNMEASURED, and THREE OF THE FOUR FAILURES ARE NEGATIVE PREDICTIONS. P05 (the positive control dies everywhere) failed. P03 (the mapping reproduces its 30%) failed -- direction five for five, magnitude four failures to reproduce. N01 (the treatment's descriptor is not lower) failed; HP-02's pilot had recorded N01 confirmed against an EARLIER DRAFT of the prompt. N02 (ordering stays zero on every corpus) failed, reproducing HP-03's retraction on two arms. PREDICTIONS-HP.md was NOT amended. FINDINGS BY CHANNEL: 0 SUITE : 17 ADVERSARIAL : 13 BLIND AUTHOR. Sealed N06 passes for the third round running and the alarm it exists to fire is firing: 1,329 green assertions produced nothing anybody did not already know. THE SUITE HAS STOPPED BEING INFORMATIVE. For the third round the most valuable single section of the record was an agent's answer to "what did you reject?". TWELVE HP-06-DF-* FILED, NONE FIXED (five in deferred_findings.yaml, the budget; all twelve with file:line evidence in FINDINGS.md). SIX OF HP-06'S OWN WRITTEN CLAIMS WERE FALSIFIED by the adversarial channel and are CORRECTED IN PLACE with the correction marked and attributed. The largest: this model spells refusals out as first-class actions, so the whole-view corpus DOES contain refusal cases and HP-06's own oracle skips all 39,688 of them -- the sealed catalogue's stated mechanism does not apply to this model. The 3-of-3 survives adversarial tracing; the framing of the zeros beside it does not. THE BEST FINDING IS ABOUT A SPECIFICATION, FOR THE FOURTH EPIC RUNNING. A blind author found that the model's COMMIT record has three fields where the feature's has four: R2's running-total clause is ABSENT from the state machine, and the manifest's own port description describes a line the model never constructs. The one mechanism with a measured, replicated edge is a hand-written sentence patching a model that does not refine its own specification. The same agent found the two arms differ in UNMUTATED code on crash consistency with nothing in the fixture able to see it, and that the fixture LEAKS ITS OWN ANSWER KEY in files blind roles are permitted to read. AND THE COST OF THE PORT, WHICH NOBODY PREDICTED: a fault in arm B's in-memory adapter survives every instrument including the hand-written suite, and arm A has no counterpart. The structure removes places for some faults to live AND creates a region no shared oracle reaches. ZERO MODEL SURFACE ADDED. A measurement ticket carries no model delta; ticket-local desired and current are the whole-program state the contributors already produced.

ticket.objective: The epic's product and the ticket every other ticket was written against. A MEASUREMENT, not a victory lap. A low or unflattering result is the preferred outcome; an epic that closes with only good news about itself has not been measured. Run the A/B from HP-01 on the integrated epic tip: same feature, arm A ordinary prompt, arm B the HP-02 prompt. Seed the same catalogue in both. Generate cases from the model, run them through each arm's adapters, and count what dies. Then judge both arms on the scorecard, TWO JUDGES, BLIND TO ARM, per references/eval_scorecard.md -- artifacts not claims, file:line for every score >= 2, a named refusal for every 4, prose quality never an input. Any dimension where the judges differ by more than 1 is `contested` and gets a third pass citing NEW evidence. Report baseline -> measured -> target per goal, with a verdict of `met`, `missed`, or `unmeasured` and a reason. Never edit a target to match a result. Never re-run selectively until a number passes. Report the run that happened. Also report, because the predecessor learned it the hard way: findings BY CHANNEL -- suite re-run, fresh adversarial attack, blind author. Both rounds of the predecessor produced their best finding from an agent asked what it REJECTED and zero from re-running the suite. If this round's findings come only from the suite, say so plainly: the suite has stopped being informative, and that alarm is meant to fire before the tool silently gets worse. FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING. A fix during a measurement destroys the measurement.
